images.subsector: Renewable power development and independent power production
images.description: National Renewable Solutions, LLC is a U.S. renewable-power developer and independent power producer that develops, finances, owns and operates utility-scale wind, solar and energy-storage projects. Current company materials report more than 3,000 MW in development, more than 1,200 MW commercialized and 190 MW owned and operated. NRS was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Minnetonka, Minnesota. On August 18, 2021, NRS announced that BlackRock's Global Renewable Power strategy had recently completed a 100% acquisition; transaction counsel identifies GRP III Norse Holdings LP as the entry buyer. An August 2025 company release continued to identify NRS as owned by a BlackRock-managed fund, although the current exact stake and legal holding vehicle were not restated. BlackRock's acquisition of GIP did not create a separate NRS ownership period. No company-level sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 23, 2026.
